cases.description: Migrates 0.6.0 -> 0.7.0 with Europe/Berlin, extracting lead 5 days and non-midnight repeat-time (09:00 and same-day 08:30) on open repeat + due + finite suspended < due tasks, stripping resolved one-shot and tombstoned blocked entries in explicit migration while preserving recurring-to-recurring and forward-reference blocked entries, and initializing history = [] and label.links = [].
Rejects 0.6.0 -> 0.7.0 conversion without sourceTimeZone/timeZone when an open task carries repeat, due, and finite suspended < due.

Chained conversion 0.5.0 -> 0.5.1 -> 0.6.0 -> 0.7.0 synthesizing modified from queued, extracting inline location rules to TDF-ID-MIGRATION-1 location blocks, and initializing label.links = [] and history = [] without requiring a time zone.
